target_service: Creativanta Video Engine (CVE) REST API v1

in_repo_harness.summary: 100% contract compatibility verified locally across 102 SDK tests and 72 ops regression tests with zero shared DB assumptions.

live_integration.description: Integration tasks outside this repository (modifying existing Creativanta service repo, production DNS, live credentials, production deployment) require separate authorized assignment.
boundary_rules: Do not modify neighboring repositories or parent checkout from this workspace.
Do not deploy live infrastructure or modify production host services without separate authorized scope.
Do not inject or commit live production credentials; use strictly verified placeholder schemas.
Coordinate external integration tasks only upon separate scope assignment by supervisor.

local_harness.description: In-memory mock or local harness instance for unit & contract testing

staging_private_beta.description: Isolated staging environment for pre-production integration testing

production.description: Commercial production endpoint (pending GA decision gate P9-05)

variables.name: CREATIVANTA_API_BASE_URL
variables.description: Target endpoint for CVE REST API v1. Must enforce HTTPS outside local development.

variables.name: CREATIVANTA_API_KEY
variables.description: High-entropy 32-byte bearer token. Stored as salted/keyed hash at rest on server. Never commit.

variables.name: CREATIVANTA_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.description: Shared signing secret for HMAC-SHA256 signature verification on incoming callbacks.

variables.name: CREATIVANTA_WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_URL
variables.description: Public or internal HTTPS webhook receiver URL registered with CVE.

variables.name: CREATIVANTA_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Timeout budget for outgoing HTTP requests to CVE API.

variables.name: CREATIVANTA_MAX_RETRIES
variables.description: Maximum automatic retries on retryable errors (409 IN_PROGRESS, 429, 503).

variables.name: CREATIVANTA_INITIAL_BACKOFF_MS
variables.description: Initial backoff delay before first retry attempt.

variables.name: CREATIVANTA_MAX_BACKOFF_MS
variables.description: Upper bound on exponential backoff delay.

variables.name: CREATIVANTA_POLL_INTERVAL_INITIAL_MS
variables.description: Initial polling interval during reconciliation (per docs/API.md line 139).

variables.name: CREATIVANTA_POLL_INTERVAL_MAX_MS
variables.description: Maximum ceiling for reconciliation polling interval.

variables.name: CREATIVANTA_GRANT_REFRESH_BUFFER_MS
variables.description: Time buffer prior to artifact URL expiration (TTL <= 300s) to trigger proactive refresh.

all_available_scopes.description: Query render jobs, status progression, execution events, and download grants
Submit render jobs, preview requests, and cancel commands
Query template catalog, inspect schemas, default variables, and bindings
Create or update tenant-specific templates and revisions
Read scene composition specifications and historical revisions
Create compositions, validate scene specs, and instantiate templates
Query asset metadata, quarantine probe status, and access grants
Request quarantine upload grants, complete uploads, and revoke assets
Register webhook endpoints, respond to challenge echo, and rotate secrets
Query operational rendering metrics, render minutes, and cost estimates
Restricted AI provider scene generation (not required for standard rendering)

domain_mappings.notes: Client provides business identifier; CVE echoes it on status, webhooks, and reconciliation without semantic interpretation.
Mandatory 1-128 char ASCII key; RFC 8785 canonical hash prevents duplicate billing or duplicate render jobs.
Pins exact template revision (e.g. revision 1). Returns immutable composition revision 1.
Isolated probe checks magic bytes, dimension bounds (<=40MP), and duration. Marked 'ready' before render.
Requires challenge handshake echo at registration. Constant-time timingSafeEqual verification.
Reconciliation stops upon reaching terminal state (succeeded, failed, canceled).
Signed bearer URL expires in 5 minutes. Auto-refreshes on 410 GRANT_EXPIRED without rerendering.

job_state_lifecycle.state_version_rule: Monotonic integer. Client must discard incoming webhook events with state_version <= last_known_state_version.
